## Changes
- **Relic score explained in the table**: each relic now shows its estimated gain on **DPS**, **gold**, **souls** and **utility** (boss timer, cooldowns, cost) as percentages, plus the weighted score. No more single opaque number.
- The estimate is relative, not additive: a +280% Siyalatas bonus is worth ~19% when Siyalatas already gives 1,370%, and ~2% when it gives 20,000%. Each relic's bonus is measured against the effect that ancient currently provides in *your* save; no summons, no gain.
- Score weights: DPS ×1, gold ×0.6, souls ×0.3, utility ×0.2 — the idle question is which four raise damage, gold buys levels, souls come from primals.
